BiblicalUsage: Yâqôsh is the word for ensnaring, for setting a trap that closes on its prey. Moses warns Israel not to desire the silver and gold on the idols, lest they be snared by it, and Ecclesiastes says men are snared in an evil time like fish in a net.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the snare is always baited with something desirable, and the only escape is to refuse the bait.
